initial_decision.brief_rationale: The verified difference of -0.1 is an observed association. The supplied table and arithmetic checks do not establish causal identification. Request archived design record R211-1 to assess whether the average causal risk difference is identified.

final_decision.brief_rationale: The lottery establishes independence from both potential outcomes; positivity, consistency, full compliance, and no interference identify the causal effect. The exact population risk difference is 8/80 − 24/120 = −0.10.
